heading: Establishment of loan guarantee program

tree.heading: Establishment.—
tree.text: In order to meet the national security objectives in section 4811(a) of this title, the Secretary of Defense shall establish a program under which the Secretary may issue guarantees assuring a lender against losses of principal or interest, or both principal and interest, arising out of the financing of the sale or long-term lease of defense articles, defense services, or design and construction services to a country referred to in subsection (b).

tree.heading: Covered Countries.—
tree.text: The authority under subsection (a) applies with respect to the following countries:

children.text: A member nation of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO).
A country designated as of March 31, 1995, as a major non-NATO ally pursuant to section 2350a(i)(3) of this title, as in effect on that date.
A country in Central Europe that, as determined by the Secretary of State—
has changed its form of national government from a nondemocratic form of government to a democratic form of government since October 1, 1989; or
is in the process of changing its form of national government from a nondemocratic form of government to a democratic form of government.
A noncommunist country that was a member nation of the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) as of October 31, 1993.

tree.heading: Authority Subject to Provisions of Appropriations.—
tree.text: The Secretary may guarantee a loan under this subchapter only to such extent or in such amounts as may be provided in advance in appropriations Acts.
